name: black_hole
submitted_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the ORIGINAL card illustration and the strict EDIT TARGET. The previous pass only swapped characters and looked plain and standard: this pass must feel INVENTIVE, reinterpreting the replaced subject as a specific Persona 3 Reload moment, character or object, while the card stays instantly recognizable at thumbnail size: same silhouettes, same action, same footprint, same camera. Keep the exact background: its palette, large shapes, lighting direction, cast shadows, magical effects, enemies and core objects stay as in Image1 unless this prompt names them. Do NOT redraw the scene, do NOT recolor globally, do NOT move or rescale anything beyond what is stated. Completely remove the replaced Regent parts (old brown/gold four-point hat-head, gold gauntlets, blue robe, armor) with no remnants left behind, and refill the cleared area with the original background shapes. Match the original's rich hard cel-shading: crisp dark outlines, deep near-black occlusion planes, clear midtone and lit planes, material thickness, purposeful small details; no blur, no soft glow, no photoreal rendering. Makoto Yuki's face and head never appear (hands and sleeves only); other characters' faces are allowed. Persona creatures' hands are plump cartoon mittens with no long human fingers. If a named character's design is uncertain, follow the described features, keep the rest simple, and never invent text. Keep important features inside x8-92%, y10-85% (crop-safe). Output: opaque, full-bleed, horizontal 1000x760, no text, letters, numbers, frame, UI or watermark. Replace the teal one-eyed enemy with a SHADOW at the same size and position, its ooze stretching and being sucked toward the center of the cyan lightning ring, its pale blue mask tilting. Inside the ring the dark center becomes a swirling vortex with a few tiny tarot cards (royal-blue backs, no text) spiralling into it. The brown rectangular slab at the lower left becomes a COFFIN lying in the same place and shape. Keep unchanged: the cyan lightning ring, the dark vines (now black ooze tendrils), the red-orange background. Character and object designs: [COFFIN] = a Dark Hour COFFIN: tall narrow six-sided coffin, near-black lacquer with thin silver trim and a pale cyan edge light, thick iron chains wrapped around it with a heavy lock (design language of Thanatos, reference mod/pck_stage/p3makoto/persona/thanatos.png). [SHADOW] = P3R SHADOW: a blob of glossy black ooze with a few dripping tendrils, wearing one pale mask (bone-white or pale blue, simple stylised face with narrow eye slits); each Shadow gets a different simple mask.
Supporting images after Image1 are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, in the listed order: mod/pck_stage/p3makoto/persona/thanatos.png. Do not import their backgrounds, other characters, poses or framing. Only use the named character/object designs specified in the prompt.
